hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f || exit 0; case "$f" in *.js|*.ts|*.tsx|*.jsx|*.json|*.yaml|*.yml) prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; }
if [ -f package.json ]; then npm test 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -f pytest.ini ] || [ -f setup.py ] || [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pytest 2>/dev/null || true; fi
